text:
DeployBot: [SAFETY] rollout v4.1.2 triggered safety-latch: error-rate spike on canary -> suggested: pause + human review (alert RWD-1422)
Maya Eng: checking charts. p50 fine, p95 doubled, handful of 502s in ap-south-1.
Luis SRE: looks like a memory regression on a subset of kernels. sampling: `gpu_mem: 95% -> oom_reclaim`
Hannah Ops: DeployBot can auto-revert. change window still open for 50m. Thoughts on auto vs manual?
Tomas PM: prefer manual unless dedicated customers impacted. want a clear comms line if we revert.
Maya Eng: agree manual. we should try a canary-only rollback and pin that region. avoid global churn.
Hannah Ops: ok I'll run the guided rollback on ap-south-1. command: `/rollout revert --scope=region --region=ap-south-1 --to=4.1.1 --ticket=RWD-1422 --reason="mem-regression-kernel"`
DeployBot: available flags: `--auto` to run immediate revert; `--dry-run` to show plan.
Hannah Ops: doing dry-run first.
DeployBot: Dry-run: will revert 3/12 nodes, drain traffic, apply pin. No dedicated pools targeted.
Luis SRE: good. once reverted monitor p95 and 5xx for 15m. if stable, pin and hold rollout.
Hannah Ops: executing revert now.
DeployBot: Revert started on ap-south-1. Progress: 1/12 nodes reverted. ETA 8m.
Maya Eng: checking logs on reverted nodes: mem spikes gone. incoming traffic p95 trending down for those nodes.
Tomas PM: drafting status page: "We paused a canary rollout in one region and reverted that region due to elevated errors. No dedicated customers affected. We'll update after investigation."
Hannah Ops: revert complete: 12/12 nodes back to 4.1.1 in ap-south-1. Pinning region to 4.1.1 now: `/model pin --region=ap-south-1 --version=4.1.1 --reason=post-revert`
DeployBot: Pin applied to ap-south-1. Rollout remains paused globally. Auto-rollback disabled for v4.1.2 until postmortem.
Luis SRE: opening internal ticket PM-ROLL-2945678901 and adding sample logs. Assign Maya + Luis.
Maya Eng: will cut hotfix branch (hotfix/kernel-guard) and add runtime check to trigger fallback earlier. ETA ~3h for tests.
Tomas PM: follow-ups: (1) update release notes marking v4.1.2 paused, (2) notify any customers with early access in ap-south-1, (3) schedule postmortem.
Hannah Ops: notifying support and comms. sending customer blurb to legal for review.
Oncall Bot: Incident created: RWD-1422. Responders: Luis SRE, Hannah Ops.
Maya Eng: after monitoring window and successful tests we'll re-run rollout with guarded kernel flag. If tests fail, we'll consider a full revert.
Hannah Ops: thanks team. Manual regional containment prevented global impact. :white_check_mark:
